plugin.name: Translator
plugin.description: Launcher translation source powered by an LLM, optionally via the LLM Control Center.
hint.title: Translate: type /tr <text>, or /tr <language> <text>
hint.subtitle: Backend: {engine} · default target: {target}
hint.subtitle_auto: Backend: {engine} (uses the Control Center when installed) · default target: {target}
notify.copied.title: Translator
notify.copied_source.body: Source text copied to the clipboard.
err.unreachable: Cannot reach the translation service. Check your network or the endpoint.
err.not_found: {engine} has no such endpoint or model (404).
err.rate_limit: Too many requests, try again later (429).
err.server: The translation service returned a server error.
err.bad_response: The response could not be parsed.
err.no_hub: The LLM Control Center plugin was not found; using another backend.
err.hub_down: The LLM Control Center is not running ({url}). Start it first.
err.hub_auth: The LLM Control Center requires an API key; set it in the plugin settings.
err.need_hub_model: The Control Center has no usable model; specify a model name in the settings.
settings.target_lang.label: Default target language
settings.target_lang.description: Language used when you type /tr <text>. You can also name it in the query, e.g. "/tr en hello".
settings.engine.label: Backend
settings.engine.description: Auto: prefer the LLM Control Center when installed; otherwise use the OpenAI-compatible API below; fall back to Google Translate when neither is configured.
settings.hub_url.label: Control Center URL
settings.hub_url.description: Leave empty to auto-detect: runtime port file, then its config, finally http://127.0.0.1:8787.
settings.hub_model.label: Control Center model
settings.hub_model.description: Leave empty to pick the first available model of the Control Center.
settings.hub_api_key.label: Control Center API key
settings.hub_api_key.description: Leave empty to read the Control Center's own config; unnecessary when it has no auth.
settings.api_base.label: API base URL
settings.api_base.description: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint including the version path, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1.
settings.api_key.label: API key
settings.api_key.description: Key used for direct requests; stored only in this plugin's local config.
settings.model.label: Model name
settings.prompt.label: Custom system prompt
settings.prompt.description: Leave empty for the built-in prompt. Use {lang} as the target language name, e.g. "Translate into {lang} and output only the translation".
settings.auto_flip.label: Translate Chinese input into English
settings.auto_flip.description: When the target is Chinese but the text is already Chinese, translate into English instead.
settings.show_engine.label: Show backend
settings.show_engine.description: Annotate results with the backend and model that produced them.
